[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Gatten Edaine''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Edaine, along with [[Laria Taphoni]] and [[Tal (Taris)|Tal]], was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and worked for the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]]. He participated in the expedition that was assigned to work with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cin Tykan]] to investigate the desolated swampland populated by [[rakghoul]]s. However, most members of the expedition were killed. Edaine was a member of a survey team, who had left along with Tykan before the attack.<ref name="TOR" />
